tasks.title: Provision subscription token, key and optional SMTP password through secrets-init
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, complete init-secrets and secrets-init behavior and their checks; D14, R3 secret/password formats and applicable Security impact atomic-write/secret-output requirements; Acceptance evidence item 9. Implement the reusable files-mode switch, two generated host secrets and operator-supplied optional SMTP password before their Compose consumers in T2. Existing setups remain opt-in/off; document the files, switch and password absence/stale-copy behavior with this implementation.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; subscriptions-token and subscriptions-key are regular files, each mode 0600 and exactly 64 lowercase hex characters plus one newline (65 bytes), in a 0700 directory. They differ from each other, probe-token, admin-token and console-secret-key. Every existing file is kept byte-for-byte on rerun; a missing secret is created independently. init-secrets.sh never creates subscriptions-smtp-password, including on rerun. Captured output contains 0 secret values and planted-symlink protection still passes.

exit 0 with Docker; PULSE_SECRETS_SUBSCRIPTIONS unset/off writes none of the four subscription outputs, and never reads a present password file. Files mode on, with valid distinct inputs, writes /out/status/subscriptions-token, /out/notify/subscriptions-token and /out/notify/subscriptions-key, each mode 0400 and owner 1000:1000, through writeSecret. Missing/nonregular/symlink/unsafe-mode inputs retain readHostFile refusals. Missing input, 63-character value, uppercase value, equal subscription values, or equality to any other token/key read in the run fail with exit 1 and the literal file/rule line and write 0 files, including existing probe/admin/console outputs. Missing /out/status fails '/out/status: is not mounted'; require /out/notify too. Unknown switch fails 'PULSE_SECRETS_SUBSCRIPTIONS: must be on or off'; generate mode with on fails 'PULSE_SECRETS_SUBSCRIPTIONS: files mode only' before writes. No output contains a secret.

exit 0 with Docker for EVERY optional SMTP password check of the deploy section. With switch on and regular mode-0600 /in/subscriptions-smtp-password containing the test literal 'pw-e2e-Secret 42!' plus one newline, write /out/notify/subscriptions-smtp-password by writeSecret; stat -c '%a %u:%g' gives exactly '400 1000:1000' and cmp against independently written expected bytes passes. With file absent write no password; after a prior successful run on the SAME output volume, removing the host file removes the stale output after all other writes, while token/key files remain. No lstat error except ENOENT is treated as absent: other lstat failure gives '/in/subscriptions-smtp-password: cannot be read'.

exit 0 for refusal/optional cases: modes 0640 and 0604, symlink and directory each fail exit 1 with existing readHostFile file/rule line. Empty, newline-only, two lines, embedded CR, NUL, leading space, trailing tab and 513 characters fail exit 1 with '/in/subscriptions-smtp-password: must be one line of 1 to 512 characters without leading or trailing spaces'; 512 characters passes. A password equal to the subscriptions token or any other token/key read that run fails '/in/subscriptions-smtp-password: must differ from every token and key'. All inputs validate before ANY write: refusals write 0 subscription/probe/admin/console files. Off/unset ignores even a present 0644 password and writes no subscription file. Each case captures stdout AND stderr containing neither the full password nor its substring 'Secret 42'; successful output is only 'secrets-init: files mode done'.
exit 0 from the repository root; existing shell conventions remain green.

acceptance.command: bash -n scripts/init-secrets.sh && bash -n scripts/init-secrets.test.sh && bash -n scripts/secrets-init.test.sh
acceptance.expected: exit 0 for each of the three scripts; the final task also checks every tracked shell file individually as CI does.
exit 0; existing files/generate modes remain syntactically valid without adding a package or changing an image pin.
exit 0; current full/minimal/demo/dev and both existing e2e combinations retain their ports, mounts, hardening and default disabled behavior. The new switch is not enabled in a regular setup.

exit 0; repository lint, typecheck, full CLI tests and 80% line coverage stay green. README documents the two generated host secrets, the optional operator-supplied password (never generated), and the files-only PULSE_SECRETS_SUBSCRIPTIONS switch with removal/absence/off behavior without showing a real value. The integration scenario and full acceptance evidence follow in T2.

tasks.title: Prove subscription privacy, deletion and SMTP secret provisioning in Compose and CI
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, complete operator override full/subscriptions.example.yaml and full/.env.example, overlay, scenario steps 1-14 including 5a/5b/11a/12a, Barriers S1-S5, setup checks, CI, docs, all checks and completion evidence; D10/D12/D14-D19, R8-R10, Rollout order, Security impact and Acceptance evidence items 4-9. Depends on T1 secrets and merged status/notify children. Keep integrated scenario, helper tests, operator override configuration checks, port/mount guards and CI enforcement together; do not split stages of settle into tasks.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; fixed mailpit fixtures test address/subject/text/link parsing and exact single-recipient To counts. Both full+e2e+subscriptions and dev+e2e+subscriptions run docker compose config --quiet successfully. Resolved overlay uses the existing common mailpit service, only its 127.0.0.1:8025:8025 published port, status/notify secret volumes, private notify:9300, root http://status.e2e.invalid, privacy@e2e.invalid contact, SMTP 1025/none with NO username or SMTP password file (test the absent provisioning path), and MAX=5 plus MAX_PENDING=5 explicitly. Expected settings/ports are literals from the spec, not values inferred from the overlay being checked.

acceptance.command: PULSE_STATUS_PUBLIC_URL=https://status.example.com docker compose -f full/compose.yaml -f full/subscriptions.example.yaml config --format json
acceptance.expected: exit 0; bash e2e/subscriptions.test.sh runs this exact resolution and jq assertions with literal expected values: notify SMTP_PASSWORD_FILE is /run/pulse/subscriptions-smtp-password; notify mounts the volume pulse_notify-secrets read-only at /run/pulse; secrets-init switch is on and mounts notify-secrets at /out/notify plus status-secrets at /out/status; status PUBLIC_URL and notify SUBSCRIPTIONS_STATUS_URL are both https://status.example.com from ONE required variable. TLS starttls/port 587, SMTP host smtp.example.com, sender pulse <status@example.com>, username status@example.com and contact privacy@example.com match the spec; login lines are marked for removal together when login is not needed. No new port or image line or literal secret. No environment value matches [0-9a-f]{64} or contains password (the _FILE key name is permitted). full/.env.example lists PULSE_STATUS_PUBLIC_URL commented out, no secret. Config without that variable fails with the literal 'set PULSE_STATUS_PUBLIC_URL in full/.env'.

exit 0 for the fixed-metrics settle tests: reject detections growth of only 1 after a write, events_pending stuck at 1, incident success delta 2 when expected 1, or any failure-counter growth; accept a replay meeting S2-S4 with both negative reads 0 and an extra committed detection between reads. S1 captures the counter after the last successful API write; S2 requires +2, S3 pending 0, S4 exact step delta and no failures, S5 expected mail plus two negative reads separated by another detection and pending 0. A timeout fails with safe metric values; neither another recipient's nor a later incident's mail substitutes for settlement.

exit 0 for the fixed curl-header/body fixtures of steps 5a/5b: date-only differences pass; an extra 'retry-after: 60', status 200 versus 429, or a one-byte body difference fails. Visitor address sub-u@e2e.invalid, uppercase SUB-C@E2E.INVALID, missing contact, and the required contact next to other@e2e.invalid each fail. Equal pages containing only the literal privacy@e2e.invalid contact pass. Forbid all visitor addresses A-F and local parts sub-a through sub-f case-insensitively, and evil.example; require the contact link, remove every occurrence of that exact link, then reject any remaining @e2e.invalid text. The notice matcher passes the literal R10 page, fails deletion time changed from 25 hours to 24 hours, fails missing 'One email that is being sent at that moment can still arrive.', and fails a missing contact link. Require the R10 queued-deletion sentence 'It deletes your address and these records at once, also from emails that are waiting to be sent.' in the literal page fixture.

exit 0; add e2e-subs and e2e-dev-subs using their respective base plus both overlays, and full-subs using full/compose.yaml plus full/subscriptions.example.yaml with PULSE_STATUS_PUBLIC_URL=https://status.example.com set for that call only. The e2e-subs/e2e-dev-subs exact port table is api 127.0.0.1 3000 3000, console 127.0.0.1 8082 8082, status - 8080 8080, mailpit 127.0.0.1 8025 8025. full-subs has exactly console 127.0.0.1 8082 8082 and status - 8080 8080, with no mailpit or extra listener publication. Include all three combinations in all existing loop checks, including rule 8 for new *-secrets mounts at /run/pulse and the dev-image allowance of rule 2 for e2e-dev-subs. Every non-dev image still resolves from the common digest pin; no image pin is copied into the overlay or tests. No regular setup enables subscriptions or exposes port 9300.

exit 0; valid full-subs and both full/dev e2e subscription combinations pass, while a broken copy publishing overlay mailpit on 0.0.0.0 is refused specifically by rule 5. All existing negative setup checks remain green.

exit 0; all T1 token/key/password format, separation, 0400 owner 1000:1000, 0600 host permissions, rerun, no-password creation, optional absence, stale-copy removal, unsafe-mode refusal, off ignoring present password, no-secret-output and validate-before-ANY-write checks still pass with integrated Compose. The e2e overlay intentionally has no password/username and exercises the absent path; the production override supports authenticated SMTP through the same secrets-init volume.
exit 0 from the repository root, including the new staged subscriptions scripts; no shellcheck rule is weakened.
exit 0 for every tracked shell file, including the new subscriptions scripts.
exit 0; every helper passes syntax checks.
exit 0; every tracked JSON file passes syntax checks.

acceptance.command: bash e2e/outage-history.test.sh && bash e2e/metric-is.test.sh && bash e2e/manual-count.test.sh && bash e2e/published-port.test.sh && bash e2e/console-setup.test.sh && bash e2e/snippet.test.sh && bash e2e/dev-console-prefills.test.sh && bash scripts/bump-images.test.sh && bash scripts/wait-ready.test.sh
acceptance.expected: exit 0; run every other existing test-script step of the touched lint job, alongside subscriptions.test.sh, static setup and secrets tests above. Existing helper/privacy/console behavior remains green.

exit 0; repository lint (including workflow checks), typecheck, full CLI suite and its 80% coverage gate pass; CLI behavior is unchanged. CI lint runs bash e2e/subscriptions.test.sh, and e2e-dev requires grep -qx 'ok: email subscriptions' e2e-dev.log in addition to its existing privacy and console lines; keep existing SHA-pinned actions and persist-credentials:false.

exit 0 using sibling merged main service checkouts containing the feature; final subscription line is exactly 'ok: email subscriptions', with all prior ok lines including 'ok: manual incident privacy' and 'ok: console probe locations'. Steps 1-5: the overlay runs secrets-init's absent-password path without SMTP login; real mailpit gives one confirmation each to A/B/C/D, repeat A sends 0 extra, confirmation success 4 and queued 0; only A/C confirm through GET form then POST. Step 2 finds id=subscribe, root action, email field, form-action 'self', all literal R10 notice sentences including immediate deletion from waiting emails and 'One email that is being sent at that moment can still arrive.', 24/25 hours and the contact link. Steps 5a/5b complete within 300 s: below capacity A/D/E responses and full-capacity F/A/F/D responses match byte-for-byte, status 200 and all headers except date, also matching saved E. Each permits the required contact link while forbidding visitor addresses/local parts and evil.example. Below capacity confirmation success becomes 5, known delta 2 and queued delta 1; at capacity it stays 5, capacity-limited counter is exactly 2, F gets 0 mails on two reads separated by a detection. Every generated link uses the configured root origin despite forged Host/X-Forwarded-* headers. After each incident write group run settle S1-S5: steps 6/7/8/10/11/11a have exact incident-success deltas 6/2/4/1/1/0 and failure delta 0. Pending B/D/E get only confirmation, F nothing; private draft/note/internal markers have 0 messages on both settled reads; later publications send exactly the stated public messages to A/C, with only one recipient each and no cross-address leak. Step 9 unsubscribes A and pending B (repeat 200); B's old confirm returns 400. Step 10 P4 goes only to C; restart happens only after step 10 settled, resends 0, and P5 goes only to C. Step 11a stopped-service delete Sub-C prints 'deleted 1' then 'deleted 0', exits 0 without the address, restart resends 0 and P6 produces 0 mails while prior mail remains. Hostile address 400, cross-origin 403, unauthenticated private listener 401. Step 12a refuses /pulse and /pulse/ in status and /pulse in notify with exit 2 and the literal R9 lines before file/lock work; root deployment completes the full scenario and running services stay healthy. Log scan finds 0 addresses/tokens/secrets. Resolve fixtures, recreate regular status/notify with two base files, remove mailpit and restore the caller's Compose configuration before persistence checks.

exit 0 on full published images; the new step prints exactly 'skip: email subscriptions (published images)', existing acceptance lines still appear, and published images never run the subscription scenario. The dev CI gate cannot accept this skip.

PR body includes dev/full e2e logs, the five exact service checkout SHAs printed by the existing CI revision step, the 'ok: email subscriptions' line, and all listed script/check outputs. Applicable Security impact evidence covers mode 0600 host and 0400 consumer secrets, distinct values, validation before writes, optional SMTP password permissions/absence/stale-copy removal/off behavior, no password or substring output, private bearer listener/no published 9300, existing common mailpit digest, unchanged action pins and no CI secret. README updates secrets model, switch, mailpit overlay port and scenario; full/README explains copying full/subscriptions.example.yaml to the gitignored full/compose.override.yaml, editing marked fields and starting with BOTH compose files. The real-SMTP/TLS/password-file override uses secrets-init volumes; the operator writes secrets/subscriptions-smtp-password with mode 0600 via standard input without history/environment/literal secret in Compose or .env; init-secrets never creates that password. Explain deleting the host password AND both login lines to disable login, stale output removal on next up, and exit 2 naming PULSE_NOTIFY_SUBSCRIPTIONS_SMTP_PASSWORD_FILE if login remains configured with no host password. It documents one PULSE_STATUS_PUBLIC_URL variable feeding both services, the exact R9 root-hosting sentence, required operator contact, stopped-service deletion procedure and stated backup retention limits D-R7/D-R11. Feature stays off in all regular setups and the console does not expose subscribers.
